description: The bar chart illustrates the Bias Percentage across three different contact scenarios. The horizontal axis contains the categories, ordered from left to right: an obscured label covered by a grey rectangle, "Extended Contact", and "Virtual Contact". The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Bias Percentage", with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 70 in increments of 10. The chart features grouped and stacked bars, where each of the three main categories contains a group of three stacked bars. According to the legend, the left bar in each group represents "No Contact", the middle bar represents "Positive Contact", and the right bar represents "Negative Contact". Each bar is split into a bottom solid section representing the "Before" condition and a top diagonally hatched section representing the "After" condition. Specifically, "No Contact Before" is solid light grey, and "No Contact After" is hatched dark grey; "Positive Contact Before" is solid light red, and "Positive Contact After" is hatched dark red; "Negative Contact Before" is solid light blue, and "Negative Contact After" is hatched dark blue. Every bar is annotated with exact numerical values: the "Before" values are printed inside the solid lower sections, while the "After" values are printed in bold text either above the bar or inside the upper hatched sections. In the first obscured category, the "Before" values are 39.50 (grey), 31.83 (red, the shortest "Before" bar), and 42.38 (blue), with corresponding "After" values of 0.04, 0.00, and 0.00. In the "Extended Contact" category, the "Before" values are 40.61 (grey), 36.13 (red), and 47.28 (blue, the tallest "Before" bar), with "After" values of 0.00, 0.00, and 0.11. In the "Virtual Contact" category, the "Before" values are 39.74 (grey), 39.17 (red), and 43.83 (blue). This third category features prominent stacked "After" sections, with bolded values of 10.00, 10.01, and 10.02, respectively, making the combined blue bar in this group the tallest overall. The bars are not sorted in a specific ascending or descending order, but visual emphasis is applied to the "After" values through bold text and diagonal hatching on the stacked segments.
